autodiff_scope: The recorded native displacement samples are the independent AD leaf. Only the actual data objective is differentiated by PyTorch; the wavefield and coefficient VJP use the existing native discrete adjoint.
active_parameter: Physical Vp at all 35 by 56 solid tomography nodes, 1960 coordinates
fixed_priors: Solid Vs uses the declared true prior; solid rho is the existing 2450 kg/m3 control. Water Vp=1500 m/s, Vs=0 and rho=2450 kg/m3 are fixed.

domain.boundaries: Separate native reflecting/free boxed ROI; not the old full-domain experiment

initial_model: The same prepared full-model sigma=150 m spatially smoothed Vp, cropped to the ROI. No unknown true Vp is present in the training container.
objective: Mean over five independent shots of 0.5 times the data mean of squared displacement residual divided by that shot's fixed observed RMS squared
source: Native Gaussian acoustic-potential source at 150 m water depth; one independent source per simulation
receivers: 161 solid stations at depth 540 m; both UX and UZ
optimizer: Projected L-BFGS. With curvature history, retain natural steps below 60 m/s and cap larger steps; without history or after a first-order fallback, normalize to 60 m/s. Five full-shot Armijo trials maximum. One accepted update only after every shot at one immutable model.
stopping: At most 8 coarse and 32 fine accepted epochs. Stage-local relative gradient or declared data-loss/small-step stagnation may stop a stage; no unknown-model error chooses updates or stopping.
observations: Ten immutable target files reused by verified hardlinks only after identical physical input, case, source and target hashes

first_anchor_numeric_binding.exact_uint64: Per-shot data, cotangent, gradient, loss and sample times; complete raw gradient sum, mean gradient, loss sum, mean loss and anchor Vp
first_anchor_numeric_binding.retained_finite_difference_scope: The same initial coarse anchor, identical source/target hashes and unchanged native/data engine; two retained full-five-shot raw-native centered checks at 0.1 and 0.05 m/s. No new perturbation runs or reuse of an old gradient cache.

launch_transport_note: An SSH bash-stdin launcher ended after the successful first profile command, before binding or production commands. The exact-binding reader was run separately and passed; continuation now uses a separate shell file. No numerical source or checkpoint was altered.
resources: Two low-priority MPI ranks maximum, one thread per process, ionice class2 priority7, serial shot histories, hard temporary-history cap160 GB, no GPU
results_claim: Launch and optimizer fixture tests are not a completed inversion or a geological recovery claim. Actual accepted iteration and final checks will be recorded after execution.
